content_descriptors.notes:
Content Note
This game includes narrative elements that touch on sensitive topics such as suicide and crime. These themes are explored as part of the story and may be emotionally impactful for some players.
We encourage you to take care of your mental and emotional well-being while playing. If you ever feel overwhelmed, it's okay to take a break or seek support.
